messages:
Jess: starting an "admin healing" pass in production this morning. target = owner/admin bindings with no changes for >180 days. will canary in a low-risk project first :seedling:
Tomasz: good. what's the KMS plan? last prune blocked automated backups when an admin was removed before we checked key policies
Jess: plan = 1) export IAM + KMS policies 2) run a local simulate/prune 3) apply to canary project 4) 30m monitor window 5) rollback if any smoke checks fail
Irene: please paste the exact queries so compliance can archive the evidence set
Jess: copying the commands i'm running now:
```
# IAM export
gcloud projects get-iam-policy redwood-canary --format=json > canary-iam.json
# KMS key policy
gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy backup-key --location=global --keyring=redwood-kr > canary-kms.json
# find owner/admin bindings
jq '.bindings[] | select(.role|test("(owner|admin|security_admin)"))' canary-iam.json
```
Sam: @devsec-bot can you queue an access-scan against the canary after apply?
devsec-bot: queued access-scan job #4728 against project redwood-canary — ETA ~12m
Tomasz: rule: do NOT remove principals that are referenced in KMS key policies. KMS member lists are a separate concern—if you see svc account principals there, escalate to infra
Jess: adding an automation guard: cross-compare iam bindings <-> kms members and block removal if overlap >0
Irene: also pull Data Access logs (last 7d) for any principals we touch — we need that for the compliance packet
Jess: running log export command now:
```
gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail="svc-deploy@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com"' --project=redwood-canary --freshness=7d --format=json > svc-deploy-logs.json
```
Sam: vuln triage note: vulnreporter flagged a potential STS token replay issue in an infra lib. when removing admin principals, ensure there are no long-lived elevated tokens that could be abused
Tomasz: can we add revoke/rotation step for any principal we modify? for GCP svc accounts rotate keys and disable old ones after smoke tests
Jess: yes — adding step: rotate keys and replace with short-lived creds for canary, revoke old keys post-smoke
Irene: what are the smoke checks so SRE knows what to validate?
Jess: smoke list: 1) API gateway healthcheck returns 200 2) background workers process a message 3) CI pipeline deploy to canary succeeds 4) audit log export still works
OpsOnCall: i'll monitor pager for 45m. ping me for manual rollback if needed
Jess: applying changes to redwood-canary now. will paste the effective diff when done
Jess: diff (stale admin removals):
```
- bindings: [ { role: roles/owner, members: ["u/alice@example.com", "u/old-admin@example.com"] } ]
+ bindings: [ { role: roles/owner, members: ["u/alice@example.com"] } ]
```
Tomasz: did the kms overlap check surface anything?
Jess: one overlap: svc-oldops@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com appears in the backup key policy. left it in and opened infra ticket INFRA-602 to replace with svc-backup-rotating
Irene: logs export looks clean on my side, no errors surfaced
devsec-bot: access-scan #4728 result: 3 findings (info): outdated-owner-bindings, kms-overlap-detected, long-lived-keys — 0 high-risk
Sam: looks ok. schedule the wider sweep but throttle to 5 projects/day and preserve the KMS-overlap guard
Jess: scheduling: 5 projects/day starting tomorrow, each with a 1h observation window and automated rollback tag if any smoke check fails
Tomasz: schedule a 15m readout with compliance to capture approvals for canary approach
Irene: attach jq outputs and logs to the runbook ticket for auditability
Jess: done — runbook RW-2381 updated with links and artifacts including log size delta and export timing metrics
OpsOnCall: no alerts in the 45m watch window, canary looks stable :thumbsup:
Jess: thanks all. next steps: pick next 4 projects, post the schedule in #eng-security tomorrow, and post a one-line summary after each apply
Sam: add me to INFRA-602 and RW-2381 for the KMS principal replacement follow-up
Irene: +1. include retention and performance metrics for the audit exports so we can verify no cost/regression impact
Jess: ack — will include log size delta and export timing in the ticket and quarterly least-privilege audit docs
Tomasz: i'll start a helper script to surface principals with no activity >90d and annotate them in the ticket for manual review
Jess: rolling this into the quarterly least-privilege playbook next week. closing monitoring watch now
OpsOnCall: closing monitoring watch. reopen if anything pops
Jess: closing thread — will follow up in RW-2381 and post status in #eng-security. thanks :sparkles:
